questions.question: Which of these animals is a mammal?
questions.funFact: A whale looks like a fish but is really a mammal that breathes air and feeds its babies milk.

questions.question: Animals that have feathers and lay eggs are called ___.
questions.funFact: Feathers keep birds warm and help most of them to fly.

questions.question: Snakes, lizards and crocodiles belong to which group of animals?
questions.funFact: Reptiles have dry, scaly skin and most of them lay eggs.

questions.question: A bat is a mammal that can fly.
questions.funFact: Bats are the only mammals that can truly fly, and they feed their young with milk.

questions.question: The largest animal on Earth is the ___ whale.
questions.funFact: A blue whale's heart is so big that a small child could crawl through its main blood vessel.

questions.question: Which of these is NOT a mammal?
questions.funFact: A snake is a reptile with scales, while dogs, cows and elephants are all mammals.

questions.question: Match each animal to the group it belongs to.
questions.funFact: Amphibians like frogs can live both in water and on land.

questions.question: Which is the fastest running animal on land?
questions.funFact: A cheetah can run as fast as a car on a highway, but only for short bursts.

questions.question: Ostriches are birds, but they cannot fly.
questions.funFact: The ostrich is the largest bird in the world and can run very fast on its long legs instead of flying.

questions.question: The largest animal that lives on land is the ___.
questions.funFact: An elephant uses its long trunk like a hand to pick up food and to drink water.

questions.question: Animals that eat only plants are called ___.
questions.funFact: Cows, deer and elephants are herbivores that spend many hours a day eating plants.

questions.question: Reptiles are cold-blooded animals.
questions.funFact: Cold-blooded animals often lie in the sun to warm up their bodies before moving about.
